experiments.carry_reason: The event's costings end before the population's first year. The measure is a permanent change of level whose last costing year is steady state, so later years compare with that year, scaled to the run year's base.

heads.note: The charge is income tax in PolicyEngine; the OBR books the measure as reduced benefit spending.

experiments.note: Removes the charge (a phase-out from £1bn stands for none), whatever later events made of its design. Families who opted out of child benefit resume it once their charge share falls below pe-uk's opt-out threshold.
sources: Finance Act 2012 Sch. 1 (Income Tax (Earnings and Pensions) Act 2003 s. 681B-681H)

label: modern_population_sensitivity
label_text: Policy experiment on the modern population: not a replay or a costing of Autumn 2010.
